summary: Deployment health check after METRO_CACHE_ROOT quoting fix. Verified frontend boots cleanly on https://cost-counter-234.preview.emergentagent.com. No Metro bundler errors (no MODULE_NOT_FOUND / ENOENT / invalid path). Dashboard renders with greeting, saldo card, all 4 range chips (7/30/60/90), and bottom nav with tab-home/history/reports/settings + fab-add. Navigation between all four tabs works. No regression detected from the .env change.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Pre-existing, not related to deployment fix.
Console error: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' Pre-existing on Reports screen SVG chart.

critical_code_review_comments: .env fix verified: METRO_CACHE_ROOT="/app/frontend/.metro-cache" is properly quoted and exported by expo (log shows: 'env: export ... METRO_CACHE_ROOT').
Expo bundler starts cleanly with Fast resolver enabled; no cache-related crashes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is offline (no backend). Frontend URL: https://cost-counter-234.preview.emergentagent.com. Key testIDs: home-screen, tab-home/history/reports/settings, fab-add, range-chip-{7|30|60|90}, dashboard-add-cta, save-transaction, amount-input, note-input. Pre-existing non-blocking console warnings for shadow* deprecation and SVG transform-origin.
rca_of_issue: The deployment blocker was: unquoted METRO_CACHE_ROOT in /app/frontend/.env caused expo env parser to reject the path. Main agent's fix (adding double quotes) is confirmed working — expo logs now show METRO_CACHE_ROOT exported successfully, Metro bundler starts and serves bundles without ENOENT/invalid path errors.
